title: SS27 Men's Season Colour Analysis
summary: Sun-faded earth tones and linen neutrals, ice blue as the new shirt colour, with butter, salmon pink and rust, and aquatic blues and orange for statements.

sections.heading: The palette
sections.body:
| Colour | Pantone TCX (nearest) | HEX | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sand | 13-1009 TCX | #DAC7AB | Core |
| Tobacco | 18-1028 TCX | #684832 | Core |
| Ice blue | 12-4805 TCX | #CBDCDF | Seasonal: the new shirt colour |
| Butter | 12-0711 TCX | #F6E199 | Seasonal |
| Salmon pink | 15-1523 TCX | #E29A86 | Seasonal |
| Rust | 18-1250 TCX | #9F5130 | Accent |

This is Forecut's SS27 menswear palette<sup>[1]</sup>. Confirm codes against a physical Pantone book before dyeing.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: Two strong colour signals came from the June shows. **Aquatic blues**, from turquoise and sky blue to electric blue, ran through leather jackets, shorts, linen shirts and loafers at Shinyakozuka, Auralee, Zegna and others<sup>[2]</sup>. **Orange**, from blood orange and rust to tangerine, appeared at Dries Van Noten, Willy Chavarria, Saint Laurent and Jacquemus<sup>[2]</sup>. Dries Van Noten also showed nude and aquamarine<sup>[3]</sup>. Paris collections leaned on monochrome palettes, notably at Celine and IM Men<sup>[4]</sup>. Leather came in camel and beige at Dior and Saint Laurent<sup>[3]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colour groups
sections.body:
- **Core:** sand and tobacco, with white and black for tailoring.
- **Seasonal:** ice blue, butter and salmon pink for shirts, knits and summer suits.
- **Accent:** rust and orange, and aquatic blue, for one piece per look (a bag, cap, jacket or shorts).

sections.heading: Combinations
sections.body:
- Ice blue shirt with sand trousers and tobacco suede.
- Head-to-toe sand or beige, including leather.
- Turquoise or sky blue shorts with a white shirt.
- Orange accessory or blouson over tobacco and sand.

timing: Ice blue and sand are rising for SS27. Aquatic blues and orange are statement colours for high summer.
products: - Ice blue: shirts. Sand and beige: suits, trousers, leather. Aquatic blue: shorts, linen shirts, leather jackets. Orange: blousons, knits, bags.
design_implications:
- Lab-dip ice blue across poplin, linen and knit; it shifts between fibres.
- Use orange as one accessory or garment per look, as runways suggested.
commercial_implications:
- Lead shirts with ice blue; keep sand and tobacco deep.
- Buy aquatic blue and orange as smaller statement buys.
